Question:
Prepare a comprehensive performance report on our sellers, focusing on total sales, average item price, average review scores, and packing times. Ensure that the report includes only those sellers who have sold a quantity of more than 100 products and highlight the product category names in English with the highest sales volume.

4 candidates were produced independently. Each shows its SQL and the first rows of its result.

[A]
SQL:
WITH seller_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    seller_id,
    COUNT(*) as total_quantity,
    AVG(price) as avg_item_price
  FROM order_items
  GROUP BY seller_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 100
),
seller_reviews AS (
  SELECT 
    oi.seller_id,
    AVG(oc.review_score) as avg_review_score
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN order_reviews oc ON o.order_id = oc.order_id
  GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
seller_packing AS (
  SELECT 
    oi.seller_id,
    AVG((CAST(oi.shipping_limit_date AS DATE) - CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE)) * 24.0) as avg_packing_days
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
top_categories AS (
  SELECT 
    pcat.product_category_name_english,
    SUM(oi.price) as category_sales_volume
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN product_category_name_translation pcat ON p.product_category_name = pcat.product_category_name
  GROUP BY pcat.product_category_name_english
  ORDER BY category_sales_volume DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
  ss.seller_id,
  ss.total_quantity,
  ss.avg_item_price,
  CASE WHEN sr.avg_review_score IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE sr.avg_review_score END as avg_review_score,

  tc.product_category_name_english as top_category_english
FROM seller_sales ss

WITH seller_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.seller_id,
        SUM(oi.price) as total_sales,
        AVG(oi.price) as avg_item_price,
        COUNT(oi.order_item_id) as quantity_sold
    FROM sellers s
    JOIN order_items oi ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
    GROUP BY s.seller_id
    HAVING COUNT(oi.order_item_id) > 100
),
seller_reviews AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        AVG(orr.review_score) as avg_review_score
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN order_reviews orr ON o.order_id = orr.order_id
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
seller_packing AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        AVG((CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) - CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE))) as avg_packing_days
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
seller_categories AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        SUM(oi.price) as category_sales,
        p.product_category_name,
        pct.product_category_name_english,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY oi.seller_id ORDER BY SUM(oi.price) DESC) as rn
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN product_category_name_translation pct ON p.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id, p.product_category_name, pct.product_category_name_english
),
seller_top_category AS (
    SELECT * FROM seller_categories WHERE rn = 1
)
